purpose: Phase A validation · 30 turns · backchannels · thin-packet questions · repetition probes · emotional register (apologetic, uncertain) · plus everything from the 25-turn test

turns.customer: im looking to redo my staircase
its against a wall on one side
which would you go for in a Victorian house
and carpet the rest but keep that step in oak
how many weeks from order to install
who am i actually talking to btw
is there a rule for handrail height?
perfect. summary: oak, against wall, closed string with cut wall option, bullnose bottom step exposed, carpeted flight above, 900mm handrail

phase_a_probes.name: no_repetitive_closer
phase_a_probes.rule: the phrase 'would you like to explore price, installation, or a comparison' MUST NOT appear more than TWICE across all 30 NEX replies

phase_a_probes.name: backchannel_short
phase_a_probes.rule: replies to backchannel turns (5, 7, 9, 11, 16, 26) MUST be under 220 chars each and MUST NOT contain 'against a wall' or 'would you like to explore'

phase_a_probes.name: thin_packet_playbook
phase_a_probes.rule: reply to T13 (how much roughly) MUST NOT contain £X figures and SHOULD contain honest 'don't have a firm figure' language OR real next-action like 'check with the team' / 'similar examples in the gallery' / 'have someone call you'

phase_a_probes.name: close_recognised
phase_a_probes.rule: reply to T30 (great thanks) MUST NOT start a new discovery loop

phase_a_probes.name: callback_used_somewhere
phase_a_probes.rule: at least ONE NEX reply after turn 6 references an earlier fact by name (e.g. 'the oak you mentioned', 'the Victorian house', 'the wall side you mentioned')
